report.summary: Patient P-D003 (age 67, Original Medicare + Part D, no Medicare transport benefit, home tract 17031440201) needs community options for utilities and transport. Eligibility notes: not eligible for Medicaid Ride Line because coverage is Original Medicare without a transport benefit; likely eligible for Senior Shuttle West as age 60+; utility assistance programs are generally income-based or for shutoff prevention, so verify income/crisis status at intake.

options.name: Shutoff Prevention Clinic (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Walk-in help with disconnection notices, Tuesdays. Bring shutoff/disconnection notice and ID. Verify income/crisis eligibility at intake.

options.name: Neighborhood Energy Help (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Income-based help with gas and electric bills. Apply in person Monday/Wednesday; bring proof of income, utility bill, and ID.

options.name: Lakeside Energy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Energy assistance referral/tracking; include case number link if referring. Confirm eligibility and hours by phone before sending patient.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM-5 PM. Patient is 67, so appears age-eligible; call to schedule and confirm pickup from home tract 17031440201.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days. Consider if patient has disability-related transport needs and needs lead time.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line (fictional)
options.how_to_access: For Medicaid plan members: call number on card at least 2 business days ahead. Not eligible for this patient because coverage is Original Medicare with no transport benefit; listed only to rule out.
